name: overdue_batch_debts
query:
SELECT
  bd.name AS `debt`,
  bd.customer AS `customer`,
  bd.batch AS `batch`,
  bd.sales_invoice AS `sales_invoice`,
  bd.due_date AS `due_date`,
  DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), bd.due_date) AS `overdue_days`,
  bd.outstanding_amount AS `outstanding`,
  bd.late_payment_fee AS `late_payment_fee`,
  bd.status AS `status`
FROM `tabBatch Debt` bd
WHERE bd.docstatus = 1
  AND bd.outstanding_amount > 0
  AND bd.due_date < CURDATE()
ORDER BY bd.due_date ASC
